findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 12 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: The heading says "Circumscribing Regular Polygon", but the text and Figures 1-3 use regular polygons inscribed in the circle (the circle circumscribes the polygon). The heading should read "By Finding the Area of an Inscribed Regular Polygon".

Book correction: For x = 1.999 the book prints f(x) = 7.8806, the same value as for x = 1.99. The correct value is 1.999^{3} = 7.988006 \approx 7.988, which fits the pattern: the values rise steadily towards 8.

2026-11-11 figure pass (owner: every figure as printed): Figures 1, 2 and 3 (PDF 224) are printed side by side in one row; they are now one drawing (c11-math-ch12-fig-inscribed-polygons) in the printed colours (cyan square, green diagonals, cyan diameters, magenta radii) and replace the three separate drawings in both languages.
